goal: remove something from git history without losing anything else

steps.name: inspect-history
steps.goal: find what is oversized and when it entered

steps.name: inspect-secrets
steps.goal: lb_secrets finds nothing in any commit before the history is republished

steps.name: verify-fastforward
steps.goal: the offending commits are unpushed, so nothing published is rewritten

steps.name: commit
steps.goal: record every uncommitted change, because the rewrite eats them

steps.name: generate-backup
steps.goal: clone .git so the rewrite is recoverable

steps.name: rewrite-history
steps.goal: strip the paths from every commit that carries them

steps.name: verify-history
steps.goal: no oversized blobs remain, commits survived, the old tip kept its sha

steps.name: push
steps.goal: send the rewritten history to the remote

steps.name: verify-remote
steps.goal: the remote matches local and the work is there
